title: Verify extracted tilemap chains in Blue Screw
changes: Add an opt-in recorded-scene check that alters the first interleaved LZ and direct tilemap chain sources in memory and requires extracted-resource counters.
validation: Source e202-second-stage-source-_impqiwz pins the second two-row selector. Wine e202-blue-audit-wine-dyl4e4jy observes the first row pair, descriptors, wrapper and direct stream. Wine e202-blue-poison-wine-9qneu93s matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and nonempty audio for 600 frames with positive row, descriptor, direct-stream and decoded LZ HLE counters; both Wine servers drained.
Windows test executable build e202-blue-build-5v7yue3l passes. Earlier e202-blue-build-3_mw7irl failed before compilation because the script path was relative to scratch.
limitations: The address audit does not identify the executing callback; other pairs, scenes, consumers, real BIOS and DMA remain open. Both Wine scene logs include the separately tracked D-Bus assertion. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurements.
